answers.rationale: The requirement specifies features typical of metal-clad switchgear construction, including door arrangements, material specifications, and compartmentalization. CROWN-ARMV is the appropriate product as it is designed for metal-clad switchgear with customizable configurations.

The minimum distance from the floor to the lowest device is a design consideration for metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV meets this requirement as it is engineered to IEEE standards and can be customized to meet specific installation requirements.
Floor sill framing and anchoring channel requirements are part of the installation design for metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV includes provisions for such installation features.
External control cable entrance from the top is a typical feature of metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV can be configured to include this feature.
Laminated phenolic screw-on nameplates are standard for metal-clad switchgear identification and labeling. CROWN-ARMV supports this feature as part of its design.

The power supply requirements, including voltage and wiring specifications, align with auxiliary power systems for switchgear. EP2-AUX provides station AC and DC distribution systems suitable for these specifications.
The ambient temperature and altitude specifications are environmental considerations for outdoor and indoor switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is designed to operate within these environmental ranges.
